name: northgo-website
description: Northgo static site with Cloudflare Pages Functions and D1 enquiry admin

scripts.dev:cf: npm run prepare:dist && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=DB --kv=MEDIA_KV
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --local --file=./migrations/0002_users.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --local --file=./migrations/0003_avatars.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --local --file=./migrations/0007_rbac.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0002_users.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0003_avatars.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0007_rbac.sql
scripts.db:users: wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0002_users.sql && wrangler d1 execute northgo-inquiries --remote --file=./migrations/0003_avatars.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run prepare:dist && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=northgo
